layout.spacing: Generous spacing, p-8 to p-24, creating a premium breathable look.
layout.rounded: rounded-2xl to rounded-[2rem] for softer components

header.classes: fixed top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[95%] max-w-7xl bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md rounded-full shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(26,42,79,0.12)] z-50 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between
header.logo: Text logo 'Executive Insights', font-bold text-xl text-[#1A2A4F]

nav_links.hover_effect: relative group. Add an absolute block at bottom-[-4px] left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-0 h-[2px] bg-[#F7A5A5] transition-all duration-300 ease-out group-hover:w-[50%]

header.cta_button: bg-[#1A2A4F] text-[#FFF2EF] px-6 py-2.5 rounded-full hover:bg-[#1A2A4F]/90 transition-colors shadow-md text-sm font-medium

mega_menu.trigger: Focus/Hover on 'Szolgáltatások' using Tailwind group-hover on the parent li
mega_menu.container: absolute top-[calc(100%+1.5rem)] left-0 w-[400px] bg-white rounded-[2rem] shadow-2xl p-6 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 border border-[#1A2A4F]/5 opacity-0 invisible group-hover:opacity-100 group-hover:visible transition-all duration-300 translate-y-2 group-hover:translate-y-0
mega_menu.item: flex items-start space-x-4 p-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-[#FFF2EF] transition-colors group/item cursor-pointer
mega_menu.icon_box: w-10 h-10 shrink-0 rounded-lg bg-[#FFDBB6]/30 flex items-center justify-center text-[#1A2A4F] group-hover/item:bg-[#F7A5A5]/30 transition-colors

hero_section.description: Background wraps around the floating top menu. Hero section sits at pt-0.
hero_section.background: Deep navy (#1A2A4F) base with an architectural image overlay mixed with bg-[#1A2A4F]/80. This makes the floating white menu pop.
hero_section.content: Centered or left-aligned text, large heading in #FFF2EF, accented with #F7A5A5. Padding top should account for the floating header (e.g., pt-40 pb-24).
hero_section.cta: bg-[#F7A5A5] text-[#1A2A4F] px-8 py-4 rounded-full text-lg font-semibold hover:bg-[#FFDBB6] transition-colors shadow-lg

sections.name: Szolgáltatások (Services List Cards)
sections.layout: Grid of 3 cards. Cards have bg-white, rounded-3xl, p-8, subtle shadow, border border-transparent hover:border-[#F7A5A5]/50. Include lucide-react icons inside an #FFDBB6/30 rounded box.

sections.name: Rólunk (About Us)
sections.layout: Split layout: 50% text / 50% image. Image uses rounded-3xl and fills container, text focuses on executive coaching authority.

sections.name: Módszertan (Methodology)
sections.layout: Bento grid or alternating rows highlighting process steps. Use #FFDBB6 as accent blocks or subtle background for specific cards.

sections.name: Esettanulmányok (Testimonials / Case Studies)
sections.layout: Large quote block or cards. Deep navy background #1A2A4F section, text in #FFF2EF to create visual tension and contrast against the #FFF2EF main body background.

sections.name: Kapcsolat (Contact Us)
sections.layout: Centered form inside a soft #FFDBB6/20 card. Rounded-3xl container, rounded-xl inputs, solid #1A2A4F submit button.

footer.classes: bg-[#1A2A4F] text-[#FFF2EF] pt-20 pb-10 px-8 rounded-t-[3rem] mt-24
footer.layout: 4 columns: Logo/Brand, Quick Links, Services, Contact. Bottom border for copyright.

interactions.hover: Smooth color transitions (duration-300). Interactive elements scale slightly (active:scale-95).
interactions.mega_menu: Opacity 0 to 1, translate-y-4 to 0 on group-hover/focus.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build strictly in React (.js / .jsx), using Tailwind CSS. NO Next.js. NO TypeScript.
The language MUST be 100% Hungarian for all visible text. Mock content with Hungarian executive coaching terms.
Adhere strictly to the requested color palette: #1A2A4F (Navy), #F7A5A5 (Coral), #FFDBB6 (Peach), #FFF2EF (Off-white).

Floating top navigation: Apply fixed, top-4, left-1/2, -translate-x-1/2, rounded-full. The Hero section must use top-0, padding-top large enough to clear the menu, and have a background that wraps 'behind' the menu.
Hover effect: Do not use border-b. Use a centered ::after block (left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2) that expands width to 50% on hover.
Mega Menu: Must show on hover/focus using Tailwind 'group-hover'. Must include icon boxes.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-services-link', data-testid='contact-submit-button').
